Explicit 300,000: thread cap Some(300000), auto_compression 270,000, legacy config without the discriminator keeps Some(300000). Caps above the model window (1,000,001) and zero are rejected. Live refresh: runner session cap 300,000 sets ccx.n_ctx 300,000; 2,000,000 clamps to model 1,000,000; cleared cap restores 1,000,000 for Unsupervised and a Supervised policy leaves n_ctx untouched.
